# ghost/currencies

Convert currency amounts in Currencies on Android without accounts or transactions. Choose source/target, set a keypad amount, swap and return the app-displayed rate with its literal date and provider.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/currencies
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/currencies open --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/currencies select_source --device <serial> --param currency=<currency>
ghost skill run ghost/currencies select_target --device <serial> --param currency=<currency>
ghost skill run ghost/currencies set_amount --device <serial> --param amount=<amount>
ghost skill run ghost/currencies swap --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/currencies read_state --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `open`: Open the currency conversion keypad and read its dated displayed rate
- `select_source`: Select the source currency by exact ISO code
- `select_target`: Select the target currency by exact ISO code
- `set_amount`: Replace the keypad amount and read the displayed conversion
- `swap`: Swap source and target and verify both selected codes
- `read_state`: Read selected currencies, both amounts, rate, date and provider
